name: Burst on a cast-iron main during frost
description: Night-time pressure collapse on Dorpsweg (D-01) while the district inlet flow jumps to daytime-peak levels. It is -4 C and there are no planned works.

alarm.message: Pressure at PS-101 below low alarm limit (2.85 bar, limit 3.00 bar).

groundTruth.explanation: 1962 cast-iron DN300 main burst in frost. Pressure fell on both sensors of the segment (more at the western one), night flow tripled, no planned works nearby.

name: Pressure dip caused by planned valve replacement
description: Pressure drops on Industrieweg (D-02) on a weekday morning while the district inlet flow goes down, not up. A valve replacement was planned for the same time.

alarm.message: Pressure at PS-201 below low alarm limit (3.72 bar, limit 4.00 bar).

groundTruth.explanation: Planned work PW-7781 (valve V-0507-B replacement) closed part of the network. Flow went down, pressure drop matches the expected impact.
